effects.intended_material: bronze plaque clang and hanging chain
wax seal tear and opening score

sections.intent: Clarinet trill rising two octaves, gold engraving accelerates to foxtrot orchestral hit. Fragment of new song in piano.
116foxtrot at a distance; muted trumpet tries unfinished theme. Elevator obstacle punctuates with wah and two dry clock ticks, true held breath.
Charleston accelerates116→138 on16published stair beats; stride piano, snare, pizzicato bass, string ascent. Hero climbs30floors.
138kitchen syncopation, seven metallic tray accents and cap knock/return; whistle first four theme notes.
Roof rush, clock hits XII then complete music stop; wind/paper flutter and Special delivery over silence.
Twelve counted B-flat tubular bells at exact STRIKES. Ivory glove catch, seal tear, score and baton; crescendo filament relays.
First full D-flat song with piano/brass/strings and eighth-note harp fan opens, overhead dancers resolve into clock.
Grand D-flat reprise beneath Happy New Year, geometric fireworks, elevator ding/corrected service plaque, soft final piano cadence.
